page.notes: The seven Ethiopic syllable glyphs in each row (Bet, Tau, Hharm, Naas, Alph, Caf, Waw, Ain, Zai) are not transcribed. They are Ethiopic (Ge'ez) characters, and at this scan resolution I cannot read them letter by letter, so each row is marked illegible at about seven letters. The Latin row labels, the vowel headers and the transliterations are read directly. Stray marks near "ho", "o" and the Naas row are ignored as ink specks, not printed text. The word "Jaman" at lower right is treated as a catchword.
